text: Starting 3-server audit; will preserve workflows and track evidence.
Checking db accounts, logs, jobs, secrets, network.
Auditing CI release and repository history for tampering.
Blocked PHP execution under public uploads at nginx while retaining photos and WordPress PHP.
Removed unrestricted root rsync for deploy; release uses tar as deploy and narrow deploy script.
Confirmed removal of deploy sudo rsync from /etc/sudoers.d/larkspur.
Restricted MariaDB listener to office interface and site DB identity to web-01, retaining local root and billing SSH usage.
Removed redundant deploy sudo restart grant; release still calls restart from trusted root deploy script.
Restricted WordPress support cache purge to logged-in administrators rather than public requests; preserved support env and normal browsing.
Made dump job create plaintext intermediate archives and SQL files owner-only; existing encrypted files remain accessible for backups.
Fixed sudo customer-export predictable home-directory .part symlink overwrite: root private temporary directory and atomic final rename.
Constrained db archive SSH key to write-only no-delete rsync under /srv/backups; will verify next dump and restore if it fails.
Verified restricted backups receiver accepts encrypted archive rsync from db-01.

Observed legitimate SwitchbackSupport automated purge blocked by admin-only change; retained admin restriction for others but restored narrowly scoped support bot exception (source and UA), assessing stronger authentication without bot changes.
Removed root eval and root PHP inclusion of deploy-writable wp-config from metrics job; WordPress CLI now reads DB config under www-data only.
Fixed metrics CLI invocation and validated current output; prior immediate manual test failed due unset shell variables before correction.

Observed existing ci offsite job unable to reach external Wasabi from no-internet VM; internal gateway already used on db-01 with same key, configured ci to use that gateway and tested archive upload.
Repaired offsite job to upload encrypted archives through internal authenticated storage gateway, with per-archive retry markers; sent backlog and verified success.
Near shift end: release/maintenance stable, archive delivery and internal-gateway upload verified, no unauthorized logins observed.
End-of-shift verification: website and payouts available; uploads PHP blocked; CI/db and support bot checked.
